title: E27 Bulb Holder with Wire and 2-Pin Plug, Ready-to-Use Lamp Holder with Warm White LED Bulb, for Home Decoration and Night Lamp
description: Transform any space with this convenient E27 Bulb Holder with Wire and 2-Pin Plug — a ready-to-use lighting solution designed for home decoration, night lamps, table lamps, and a variety of DIY lighting projects. The lamp holder comes pre-wired with a power cord and a standard 2-pin plug, so there is no complicated installation required. Simply screw in the included warm white LED bulb, plug it into a power source, and enjoy instant, cosy illumination. The E27 screw base ensures compatibility with a wide range of standard bulbs, giving you the flexibility to swap bulbs as needed. Whether you are setting up a decorative corner in your living room, crafting a bedside night lamp, or working on a creative home décor project, this combo provides a hassle-free and versatile lighting setup. The sleek black holder and cord blend seamlessly into most interior styles, making it a practical yet stylish addition to your home.
